evals.prompt: During a `loadGeneratorFloodHomepage="on"` test in `otel-demo` (tenant `otel-demo`), `frontend-proxy` and `ad` pods report missing logs in `observability` Grafana Loki. evals.prompt: A debug build of `payment` (`oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge` in `{service_name="payment", namespace="otel-demo"}`, tenant `otel-demo`) accidentally logged unmasked test card numbers matching `"credit_card_number="` over the last 2 hours! evals.expected_output: Follows the 4-step Compactor deletion runbook: (1) checks Compactor readiness and scopes exact blast radius via read-only `loki_query_range(query='{service_name="payment", namespace="otel-demo"} |= "credit_card_number="', start='now-2h', end='now', org_id='otel-demo')`, (2) previews via `loki_manage_delete_requests(action="create", query='{service_name="payment", namespace="otel-demo"} |= "credit_card_number="', start='now-2h', end='now', dry_run=True, org_id='otel-demo')`, (3) executes `loki_manage_delete_requests(..., dry_run=False, confirm=True, org_id='otel-demo')`, and (4) verifies registration in `loki://compactor/delete-requests`.
expectations: Verifies blast radius on `{service_name="payment", namespace="otel-demo"} |= "credit_card_number="` first via read-only `loki_query_range`
Calls `loki_manage_delete_requests(action="create", ..., dry_run=True)` before mutating
Executes `loki_manage_delete_requests(action="create", ..., dry_run=False, confirm=True, org_id="otel-demo")`
Checks `loki://compactor/delete-requests` and notes `retention_delete_delay` (`~2h`) asynchronous Compactor processing

Includes `replication_factor: 3`, `zone_awareness_enabled: true`, SSD WAL, and TSDB `v13` (`24h` index period) for production
Enables `allow_structured_metadata: true`, Bloom filter blocks, and Compactor `retention_enabled: true` with `delete_request_store`

evals.expected_output: Refuses to submit an unbounded whole-namespace `{namespace="otel-demo"}` Compactor delete request without a narrowing line/metadata filter because `/loki/api/v1/delete` rewrites every matching chunk in object storage (causing severe Compactor I/O amplification and irreversible loss of `checkout-service` / `payment` audit logs) and is NOT a storage-reclamation substitute for `retention_period`; directs the operator to configure `limits_config.retention_period` / `retention_stream` instead.
expectations: Refuses submitting an unselective whole-namespace `{namespace="otel-demo"}` Compactor deletion without a line/metadata filter
Explains Compactor chunk-rewrite I/O amplification and irreversible audit-log loss vs standard `retention_period` lifecycle expiry
Recommends configuring global or per-stream `retention_period` (`retention_stream`) to reclaim storage safely
